title: Tesla Reportedly Using a Driver-Assistance System Struck a Pedestrian in a Fatal Crash in Vallejo, California
summary: A Tesla driver reportedly told police that Full Self-Driving, a supervised driver-assistance system, was engaged when the vehicle struck a 71-year-old pedestrian crossing Interstate 80 in Vallejo, California. The Tesla reportedly braked and veered left before impact. At least one other vehicle was reported to have then struck the pedestrian, who died. The driver stopped and supplied dashcam footage.
